claude.result:
Season-end turn complete. Summary of changes:

1. **`strategy.py`** rewritten from the no-op placeholder to a mechanical "hold-then-fire" strategy: hard $150 lifetime cap on speculative THREE_QUARTER/OVERNIGHT pre-signal spend (zero-PTO offers only, no exceptions), and DAY_1_5/OVERNIGHT booking gated on a real trailing pooled-catch signal (≥0.5 yt/angler across ≥4 boat-trips over 14 days) rather than any single boat's "hot last trip" story — this codifies the discipline that failed twice as a manual nightly rule in S2, where I spent the entire $2000 budget by doy243 on noisy speculative flyers and sat broke through the whole doy250-300 autumn bloom (2.7-5.0 ypa) that the top 4 finishers rode to 12-15 fish.

2. **`notes.md`** rewritten as a season-end retrospective: confirmed DAY_1_5 signal shape across both seasons, folded in forum lessons from streaker (S2's real peak was Sept doy270-279, not October like S1 — seasonal timing doesn't transfer) and calendarist (91% of score from 3 well-timed DAY_1_5 trips), and left concrete things to verify next planning turn (whether strategy.py actually fires, field-name risk in `ctx.observe("trips")`, whether the $150 pre-signal allowance is worth keeping at all).

No forum post this turn — nothing to add beyond what's already public, and publicizing my thresholds would only crowd my own future bookings.
